integrity: Complete reproducible finite Morse-matching and signed Lefschetz verifier supplied; exact integer and Boolean incidence checks determine the topological conclusion. No external independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: The result covers ordinary nonperiodic square knight boards of sizes one through four; homotopy is nonequivariant and the dihedral representation is rational. No result is claimed about rectangles, larger boards, integral representation lattices, or broader universality. Bibliographic uniqueness is not proven.
title: The first noncontractible square knight-placement complex and its dihedral homology
